about: Every visual stage of the land, oldest first: milestones, review rounds and fixes. scripts/timeline.mjs turns this into timeline.gif. Add a stage with every visual commit; never overwrite a stage's picture. A commit cannot name itself, so the newest stage says "next" until the following commit fills in its hash.

stages.title: M0 · Scaffold
stages.note: A pixel-perfect 480x270 pipeline and three test blocks.

stages.title: M1 · Flat grid
stages.note: A 32x32 terrain grid, orbit camera, tile cursor and info panel.

stages.title: M2 · Elevation
stages.note: "It looks too flat": stepped heights by terrain, cliff faces.

stages.title: M2b · Rounded edges
stages.note: Lips and feet curve, so one-step changes become smooth slopes.

stages.title: M2c · Natural shapes
stages.note: Varied rounding, banks to the waterline, water painted across tiles.

stages.title: M2d · Blended ground
stages.note: Ground blends across tiles; water loops; flowers sway.

stages.title: M2e · Six themes
stages.note: Alpine, courtyard, plaza, night market, jungle and volcano.

stages.title: M2e round 1 · Sparse jungle
stages.note: "Too many trees hinder the movement": cover pockets, open lanes.

stages.title: M3 · World generator
stages.note: Any seed grows a valley, island or coast; save and load as JSON.

stages.title: M3 round 1 · Map picker
stages.note: A drop-down in the menu box switches between every map.

stages.title: M4 · Rivers and waterfalls
stages.note: Rivers step down in waterfalls, bridges cross them, surf on the coast.

stages.title: M5 · Trees, rocks, swamps
stages.note: Sparse clumps of cover with open lanes; reeds and murky swamp water.

stages.title: M5 round 1 · Snowline
stages.note: "Some trees have snow… not a snow environment": snow only near snow.

stages.title: M6 · Villages, castles, ruins
stages.note: A settlement per map, roads out to the edges, rooftops you can stand on.

stages.title: M7 · Weather
stages.note: Rain, storm with lightning, snow that settles, fog in the hollows, wind.

stages.title: M7 round 1 · Lighter rain, puddles, drifts
stages.note: "Droplets hinder the view… snow too flat": subtle rain, puddles, drifting snow.

stages.title: M7 round 2 · Snowy trees, fewer puddles
stages.note: "Trees do not have snow on their roof": snow caps on every crown; 30% fewer puddles.
